preconditions.description: The number of planets n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of plans q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The index of earth s is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t, *args in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan type t is between 1 and 3 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for t, v, *args in plans if t == 1)
preconditions.description: For plan type 1, the planet v is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n for t, v, u, w in plans if t == 1)
preconditions.description: For plan type 1, the planet u is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**9 for t, *args, w in plans if t == 1)
preconditions.description: For plan type 1, the cost w is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for t, v, l, r, w in plans if t in (2, 3))
preconditions.description: For plan types 2 and 3, the planet v is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for t, v, l, r, w in plans if t in (2, 3))
preconditions.description: For plan types 2 and 3, the range [l, r] is valid with 1 <= l <= r <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**9 for t, *args, w in plans if t in (2, 3))
preconditions.description: For plan types 2 and 3, the cost w is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] >= 0 or output[i] == -1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either a non-negative integer or -1.
The cost to get from earth to earth is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or output[i] == min_cost(i+1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the minimum cost to get from earth to the corresponding planet, or -1 if it's impossible.
